finding: CLI command bound exact file mutation scope; IDE gateway called shared agentLoop without that binding. Real provider mutation schemas differ. The IDE model requested a wrong integration directory and the execution wrote it. Both model instruction violation and missing evaluation boundary are retained.
scoreImpact: The affected first-run-linux-jetbrains already has historical success, so fixing this path does not automatically reduce the remaining nine historical gaps. No old failed run is upgraded.
remediation: Bind trusted launcher file allowlist and file-tool ceiling at shared agentLoop; preserve caller narrowing/empty/read-only tool ceilings; reject invalid or widened bindings before provider dispatch; keep same-name external executors from erasing builtin schema projection in that hermetic context.

releaseDecision.cli: Shared runtime source fix should ship through a later CLI release after exact-commit CI and strict-sandbox matrices pass. No emergency release is inferred from evaluation-only behavior.
releaseDecision.idePlugins: No IDE protocol or plugin source defect established here; existing plugins use CLI gateway. Rebuild only if CLI pairing or compatibility policy requires it.
releaseDecision.harness: Output-limit preservation and internal-summary length verdict fixes live in diagnostic broker/scripts and do not themselves require npm/IDE publication.
releaseDecision.paidRetests: Held by user; offline regressions do not count as model acceptance.
